# PPR June 9 Release

_Category: Past Releases · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**pheath** (6/9/2022):

* **Ticket 12430** - When entering or amending General Collateral text using the new WYSIWYG editor, adding text and removing it all resulted in registration completions without any General Collateral text or errors. This has been corrected so there must be printable characters in the final General Collateral text box.
